settings.export.explain: Easpórtálfaidh sé seo do shonraí pearsanta go léir atá stóráilte inár mbunachar sonraí mar chomhad JSON. Áirítear leis seo do phróifíl, do scéalta, do stair léitheoireachta, iontrálacha dialainne, nótaí pearsanta, staitisticí scríbhneoireachta, leabharmharcanna, liostaí léitheoireachta, gníomhaíocht phobail, ballraíochtaí, agus gach sonra eile a bhaineann le do chuntas.
settings.delete.title: Scrios Cuntas
settings.delete.warning: RABHADH: Trí do chuntas a scriosadh, caillfidh tú rochtain ar an gcuntas seo go buan agus níl aon bhealach ann chun é a aisghabháil. Scriosfar go buan gach sonraí príobháideacha, lena n-áirítear iontrálacha dialainne, nótaí pearsanta, stair léitheoireachta, agus staitisticí scríbhneoireachta.
settings.delete.published: Tá ábhar foilsithe agat ar an ardán. Má scriosann tú do chuntas, déanfar d'oibreacha foilsithe a dhíláithriú (bainfear d'ainm agus faisnéis do phróifíle) seachas iad a scriosadh. Cuirfear "[scriosta]" in ionad do chuid nótaí tráchta. Más mian leat d'oibreacha a dhífhoilsiú ar dtús, déan sin le do thoil sula scriosann tú do chuntas.

In Basecamp, cuireann riarthóir an chuntais róbat comhrá le Campfire an tionscadail agus cóipeálann sé a URL línte, a thosaíonn le https://3.basecampapi.com/. Greamaigh thíos é agus roghnaigh cad atá le postáil. Níl ach an teideal agus nasc sna línte, gan aon rud príobháideach.

settings.integrations.patreon.draftTiers: Oscail gach leibhéal chun a phraghas agus a bhuntáistí a sheiceáil, ansin sábháil é. Is i ndollair SAM atá praghsanna Patreon. Ní chuirtear leibhéal ar díol go dtí go sábhálann tú é agus go mbíonn do chlub lucht leanúna oscailte.
settings.integrations.patreon.postsHelp: Is dréachtaí ar <link>do bhlag</link> iad na postálacha iompórtáilte. Fanann postálacha a bhí do phátrúin amháin teoranta do bhaill an chlub lucht leanúna. Ní fhoilsítear aon rud go dtí go bhfoilsíonn tú é.
settings.integrations.patreon.inviteHelp: Ní cheadaíonn téarmaí Patreon dúinn teagmháil a dhéanamh le do phátrúin, agus ní féidir a n-íocaíochtaí a aistriú. Ina áit sin, roinn nasc do chlub lucht leanúna ar Patreon, ionas gur féidir le pátrúin dul isteach anseo iad féin. Leanann a mballraíocht Patreon ar aghaidh go dtí go gcuireann siad ar ceal ansin í.

settings.tracking.socialButtons.descript: Roghnaigh an féidir le líonraí sóisialta a gcnaipí is maith liom agus comhroinnte a lódáil sa bhrabhsálaí seo. Is féidir leat iad a mhúchadh sna roghanna fianán. Beidh na gnáthnaisc chomhroinnte fós ar fáil.
settings.ai.usage.title: Literary Universe AI usage
settings.ai.usage.off: AI on Literary Universe keys is switched off at the moment. The assistant still works with your own provider keys.
settings.ai.usage.explained: The assistant runs on Literary Universe keys by default and is paid from your usage balance. Each reply shows what it cost. Your own provider keys are an alternative and are never charged here.
settings.ai.usage.lasting: {amount} of what is left is credit, which does not reset.
settings.ai.usage.allowance: Your plan includes {amount} of AI usage each calendar month. Unused usage does not carry over.
settings.ai.usage.noMonthlyAllowance: Your plan has no monthly AI allowance. Storyteller includes one, or buy credits below.
settings.ai.credits.title: Credits
settings.ai.credits.explained: Credits are added to your balance and never expire. Your monthly allowance is used first. Prices are in US dollars before tax; checkout adds tax and can show your local currency.
settings.ai.credits.bought: Thank you. Your credits appear in your balance once Stripe confirms the payment, usually within a minute.
settings.ai.credits.failed: Checkout could not be started. Please try again later.
settings.ai.usage.summaryError: The usage summary could not be loaded.
settings.ai.usage.none: No platform AI usage yet this month.
settings.ai.usage.pricesExplained: USD per million tokens, including the platform margin. A cache write stores the start of the conversation once; later turns re-read it as cached input. Web search is charged per search, on top of the tokens its results add.
settings.ai.usage.priceDeepL: DeepL translation and rephrasing in the assistant: {price} per million characters sent.
settings.apiKeys.scope.story.edit.desc: Cuir meiteashonraí scéalta agus nótaí an údair in eagar

settings.apiKeys.scope.comic.write: Cruthaigh agus cuir greannáin in eagar
settings.apiKeys.scope.comic.write.desc: Cruthaigh greannáin agus caibidlí, uaslódáil clúdaigh agus leathanaigh, agus cuir sraitheanna téacs in eagar
settings.apiKeys.scope.comic.publish.des: Foilsigh nó sceidealaigh caibidlí greannáin do léitheoirí agus do léitheoirí béite. Nuair a fhoilsítear an chéad chaibidil do léitheoirí, foilsítear an greannán freisin
settings.apiKeys.scope.community.read.de: See who follows you, joins your mailing lists, comments on and reviews your work, attends your events and buys from you, with the email addresses of mailing list subscribers
settings.apiKeys.scope.diary.read.desc: Faigh rochtain ar iontrálacha do dhialainne scríbhneoireachta agus ar shraitheanna laethanta scríbhneoireachta as a chéile
settings.apiKeys.scope.author.manage.des: Riarthóirí amháin. Ligeann sé don eochair seo a ceadanna eile a úsáid ar scéalta agus ar chruinneanna aon údair, mar shampla chun clúdaigh a uaslódáil d’údair a bhainistíonn tú

settings.oauth.permissions: The app will be able to:
settings.oauth.revokeHint: Is féidir leat é seo a chúlghairm am ar bith in Socruithe → Comhtháthuithe → Eochracha API.
settings.oauth.error.unknownClient: This app is not registered with Literary Universe. Go back to the app and start the connection again.
settings.oauth.error.invalidRequest: The app sent a request Literary Universe cannot complete. {description}
settings.integrations.apiKeys.summary: Eochracha do do scripteanna agus d'uirlisí féin, eochracha do sholáthraithe AI, agus na haipeanna atá ceangailte agat.

settings.webhooks.event.chapterPublished: A chapter of your story is published
settings.webhooks.event.blogPostPublishe: A post on your blog is published
settings.webhooks.event.mailingListSubsc: Someone joins your blog mailing list
settings.webhooks.event.mailingListUnsub: Someone leaves your blog mailing list
settings.webhooks.event.attendeeChanged: Someone changes whether they attend your event
settings.webhooks.paused: Paused: the address kept refusing deliveries for three days. Fix it on the other service, then turn the webhook on again.
settings.webhooks.removeConfirm: Stop sending events to this address? A Zap or workflow listening there gets nothing more.
settings.webhooks.testQueued: A test event is on its way. It is marked "test": true and carries sample data.
settings.webhooks.chooseEvents: Choose at least one event to send.
settings.webhooks.invalidUrl: Use the full https:// address the other service gives you.
settings.webhooks.limit: You can have up to {max, number} webhooks here. Remove one to add another.
settings.webhooks.secret: Webhook added. Its signing secret is shown only now. To check that a delivery came from Literary Universe, compare the LU-Signature header with an HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the body, made with this secret.
settings.webhooks.intro: Send what happens on Literary Universe to Zapier, n8n, Apify or any other service that takes a webhook. Paste the address that service gives you, such as a Zapier Catch Hook, an n8n Webhook node or an Apify Actor run URL, and choose the events it should get. Zaps and n8n workflows that subscribe on their own appear here as well.
settings.webhooks.inbound: To bring things into Literary Universe from those services, give them an <link>API key</link>. n8n can also work with your stories through its MCP Client node at {mcpUrl}.
settings.webhooks.rotateConfirm: Make a new signing secret? The old one stops working at once, so update it wherever you check signatures.
settings.webhooks.rotated: The new signing secret, shown only now:
settings.webhooks.title: Webhooks
settings.integrations.apps.summary: Cruthaigh aipeanna a ligeann do dhaoine logáil isteach le Literary Universe nó a leathnaíonn é, agus cuir isteach iad don chatalóg seo.
settings.oauth.scope.profile.desc: D'ainm úsáideora, d'ainm taispeána agus d'abhatár
settings.apps.error.notVerified: Fíoraigh do sheoladh ríomhphoist sula dtógann tú aipeanna.
settings.apps.error.limit: Tá teorainn 10 n-aip bainte amach agat. Scrios ceann acu ar dtús.
settings.apps.error.describe: Déan cur síos ar a ndéanann an aip in 20 carachtar ar a laghad sula gcuireann tú isteach í.
settings.apps.error.invalid: Seiceáil na réimsí. Ní mór do sheoltaí HTTPS a úsáid. Ní féidir le seoltaí atreoraithe HTTP a úsáid ach ar localhost.
settings.apps.secretOnce: Cóipeáil an rún anois agus coinnigh ar do fhreastalaí é. Ní thaispeánfaidh Literary Universe arís é.
settings.apps.quickstart.title: Tóg ar Literary Universe
settings.apps.quickstart.signIn: Chun ligean do dhaoine logáil isteach le Literary Universe, cruthaigh aip thíos agus tabhair a haitheantas cliaint d'aon leabharlann OpenID Connect. Iarr na raonta {scopes} chun ainm úsáideora, ainm agus abhatár an duine a fháil sa chomhartha ID. Ní mór do gach aip PKCE le S256 a úsáid.
settings.apps.quickstart.api: Chun oibriú le scéalta, cuir ceadanna leis an aip agus seol a comhartha rochtana chuig an GraphQL API ag {graphql}. Déanann an TypeScript SDK ({sdk}) agus an uirlis líne ordaithe lu é seo duit. Ceanglaíonn cúntóirí AI le {mcp}.
settings.apps.quickstart.discovery: Aimsíonn leabharlanna OpenID Connect gach críochphointe ag {discovery}. Do script nach ritheann ach tusa, is simplí eochair API.
settings.apps.quickstart.submit: Nuair a bhíonn an aip réidh do dhaoine eile, cuir isteach í. Tar éis athbhreithnithe, feictear in Comhtháthuithe í agus deir a leathanach logála isteach go ndearna Literary Universe athbhreithniú uirthi.
settings.apps.intro: Is féidir le haipeanna a thógann tú ligean do léitheoirí agus do scríbhneoirí logáil isteach lena gcuntas Literary Universe agus, lena gcead, oibriú lena gcuid scéalta.
settings.apps.editReview: Má shábhálann tú athruithe, seoltar an aip ar ais le haghaidh athbhreithnithe. Go dtí sin, níl sí liostaithe.
settings.apps.name: Ainm
settings.apps.description: Cur síos, a thaispeántar in Comhtháthuithe nuair a bhíonn an aip liostaithe
settings.apps.redirectUris: Seoltaí atreoraithe, ceann amháin in aghaidh an líne. Úsáid HTTPS, nó HTTP ar localhost.
settings.apps.confidential: Tá freastalaí ag an aip ar féidir leis rún cliaint a choinneáil slán
settings.apps.confidential.hint: Fág é seo múchta d'aipeanna sa bhrabhsálaí, ar fhóin nó ar an ríomhaire deisce.
settings.apps.scopes: Ceadanna a fhéadfaidh an aip a iarraidh, seachas logáil isteach
settings.apps.notFound: Níl an aip seo ann nó is le duine eile í.
settings.apps.rotate.confirm: Rún cliaint nua a chruthú? Stopfaidh an ceann reatha ag obair láithreach.
settings.apps.delete.confirm: An aip seo a scriosadh? Logálfar amach aisti gach duine a úsáideann í, agus ní féidir é seo a chealú.
settings.apps.notListed: Níl an aip seo liostaithe a thuilleadh.
settings.apps.mayAsk: Nuair a logálann tú isteach, féadfaidh an aip iarraidh:
settings.apps.screenshots.label: Seatanna scáileáin, suas le {count}
settings.apps.videoUrl: Físeán, nasc le taispeántas nó le treoir
settings.apps.requirements.label: Riachtanais: an córas, bogearraí eile, cuntais nó plean a theastaíonn ó dhaoine

settings.integrations.obsidian.summary: Scríobh do scéalta in Obsidian agus coinnigh iad i sioncrónú le Literary Universe.
settings.integrations.obsidian.pull: Tagann do chaibidlí isteach i do stór mar nótaí Markdown.
settings.integrations.obsidian.push: Téann caibidlí a chuireann tú in eagar ar ais mar dhréachtaí. Ní dhéantar do nótaí a fhorscríobh riamh: má athraíodh caibidil sa dá áit, sábháiltear leagan Literary Universe in aice le do nóta.
settings.integrations.obsidian.signIn: Sínigh isteach ó shocruithe an bhreiseáin agus lig dó do scéalta a léamh agus a chur in eagar. <link>Conas a oibríonn an breiseán</link>
